items.title: The stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms computes the homomorphisms of the stalks for finitely presented modules
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement compares the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms from a module to another module with the module of homomorphisms between the stalks, proving injectivity in finite type and bijectivity in finite presentation (author lemma at source lines 3835-3848, label lemma-stalk-internal-hom). The proof (source lines 3850-3925) first tests a local homomorphism on finitely many local generators to get injectivity, then uses a local presentation of the module and the exactness of the sheaf of homomorphisms in the first variable to present both the stalk of the sheaf of homomorphisms and the module of homomorphisms of the stalks as kernels of the same map, whence they agree (proof lines 3887-3924). The comparison of the two exact sequences is the content; the required exactness statement is reproduced verbatim as a context span. H2.
